description: Retrieve the Tronsave internal account profile for the current logged-in session (wallet/represent address, balances, deposit address). Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when the user needs their linked address or balance. Returns `{ id, balance (SUN string), representAddress, depositAddress }`; any API key in the payload is masked. Read-only.
name: tronsave_get_internal_account

anyOf.description: MASKED internal API key; the full key is never returned.

apiKey.description: MASKED internal API key; the full key is never returned.

anyOf.description: Internal balance in SUN as a decimal string (TRX = SUN / 1e6).

balance.description: Internal balance in SUN as a decimal string (TRX = SUN / 1e6).

anyOf.description: TRON base58 deposit address; send TRX here to top up the internal balance (min 10 TRX).

depositAddress.description: TRON base58 deposit address; send TRX here to top up the internal balance (min 10 TRX).

anyOf.description: TRON base58 address that represents (owns) the internal account.

representAddress.description: TRON base58 address that represents (owns) the internal account.

title: Internal Account Information
